description: This PHP class defines a console command for synchronizing users from LDAP in the OrangeHRM system. It handles configuration checks, executes LDAP synchronization, tracks sync status, and handles errors.

classes.name: LDAPSyncUserCommand
classes.description: A console command for synchronizing LDAP users, handling configuration validation, process execution, and error handling within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command used to invoke it via CLI.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's description and arguments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the LDAP synchronization process, manages sync status, and handles exceptions.
